Name: Seasonal Peachy Wizard Sprite for Dizor and SVE - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
Author: chouxbunny
Description:
hi! this is my first mod so i'm not sure how to make it have its own content patcher settings, you will need to manually download it and its dependency.
if anyone knows how to work around this to make it an independent mod, please let me know!

i installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12108]Dizor's Seasonal Wizard - Vanilla and SVE[/url] and love him so much! however, his skin colour in his walking sprite was much paler than his portrait, and it's always bothered me that his sleeves and hair on the fall sprite aren't quite matching either. i whipped this up to fix that so they match. i think he'd look good with the vanilla style portraits too though, so i thought i'd share him :)

because i am relying on the actual settings from Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE that make it work with content patcher, you will need to install that first!

[INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS]
open up your mods folder and overwrite the contents of your [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE folder with the contents of this mod. that's it!

Downloads.Description: please manually extract this into your mods folder and let it overwrite the wizard's files in SVE slightly cuter aesthetic!
